elements.element: Trigger: on expiry or termination of the Agreement
elements.evidence: "Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason"
"TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance"

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
Return of Customer Data within 30 days (running from expiry/termination)
elements.evidence: "within 30 days of such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content and other Client data"

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format

elements.evidence: "(c) thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems"
"certify such deletion to Client in writing"
"for up to 6 months" exceeds 90 days of availability
"within 30 days of such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content"

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are express: 6-month transition window at then-current rates, 30-day return in standard machine-readable format measured from expiration or termination, then deletion with written certification.

The "at Client's request" condition attaches only to transition assistance; the data-return, deletion and certification duties remain mandatory, so the request condition does not swallow the return obligation.

Inserted as a single new section after the termination provisions where no transition or data-return clause existed; nothing in Sections 13-14 is altered, and no undefined term is introduced (Client Content, Client and TrueLink are all existing defined/named terms).
